evidence: Skip to main content ROOMS SERVICES EXPLORE CUSCO GALLERY CONTACT EN Sign In Book Now NEARBY 08 Explore Cusco Discover the wonders that await just outside your door All Historical Nature Cultural Adventure HISTORICAL 112 km 4h by train Machu Picchu The iconic Inca citadel and UNESCO World Heritage Site. One of the New Seven Wonders of the World. View Guide NATURE 15 km 30m by car Sacred Valley of the Incas A picturesque valley dotted with traditional Inca villages, agricultural terraces, and impressive archaeological ruins. View Guide HISTORICAL 2 km 10m by car / 30m walk Sacsayhuaman An immense Inca fortress featuring megalithic stones fitted together with extraordinary precision above Cusco city. View Guide ADVENTURE 100 km 3h by car + 2h hike Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) A dramatic mountain displaying natural stripes of turquoise, gold, and magenta at 5,200 meters altitude. View Guide CULTURAL 0.3 km 3m walk San Pedro Central Market Cusco's most vibrant market, located steps from our hotel, overflowing with fresh juices, local foods, and handicrafts. View Guide CULTURAL 0.8 km 10m walk Cusco Plaza de Armas Cusco's historic central square, framed by the Cathedral, Church of the Society of Jesus, and colonial arcades. View Guide HISTORICAL 0.7 km 8m walk Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun) The most sacred temple of the Inca Empire, dedicated to the Sun God Inti, upon which Santo Domingo Convent was built. View Guide CULTURAL 1.2 km 15m walk San Blas Neighborhood Cusco's bohemian artisan quarter, famous for narrow cobblestone streets, woodcarving workshops, and panoramic views. View Guide NATURE 50 km 1h 30m by car Maras Salt Mines Over 3,000 terraced salt pools fed by a warm subterranean saltwater spring since pre-Inca times. View Guide HISTORICAL 53 km 1h 20m by car Moray Archaeological Site Striking concentric circular agricultural terraces designed by the Incas to simulate varied microclimates. View Guide HISTORICAL 60 km 1h 45m by car Ollantaytambo A living Inca town featuring a monumental fortress and terraces, serving as the main train station to Machu Picchu. View Guide CULTURAL 33 km 45m by car Pisac Archaeological Site & Market A vast hilltop archaeological complex paired with a famous artisan market down in the valley town. View Guide ADVENTURE 120 km 3h by car + 1.5h hike Humantay Lake A dazzling turquoise glacial lake sitting at the foot of the snow-capped Humantay Mountain at 4,200m elevation. View Guide NATURE 15 km 30m by car Sacred Valley of the Incas A picturesque valley dotted with traditional Inca villages, agricultural terraces, and impressive archaeological ruins. View Guide ADVENTURE 100 km 3h by car + 2h hike Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) A dramatic mountain displaying natural stripes of turquoise, gold, and magenta at 5,200 meters altitude. View Guide CULTURAL 0.8 km 10m walk Cusco Plaza de Armas Cusco's historic central square, framed by the Cathedral, Church of the Society of Jesus, and colonial arcades. View Guide HISTORICAL 0.7 km 8m walk Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun) The most sacred temple of the Inca Empire, dedicated to the Sun God Inti, upon which Santo Domingo Convent was built. View Guide CULTURAL 1.2 km 15m walk San Blas Neighborhood Cusco's bohemian artisan quarter, famous for narrow cobblestone streets, woodcarving workshops, and panoramic views. View Guide NATURE 50 km 1h 30m by car Maras Salt Mines Over 3,000 terraced salt pools fed by a warm subterranean saltwater spring since pre-Inca times. View Guide HISTORICAL 53 km 1h 20m by car Moray Archaeological Site Striking concentric circular agricultural terraces designed by the Incas to simulate varied microclimates. View Guide HISTORICAL 60 km 1h 45m by car Ollantaytambo A living Inca town featuring a monumental fortress and terraces, serving as the main train station to Machu Picchu. View Guide CULTURAL 33 km 45m by car Pisac Archaeological Site & Market A vast hilltop archaeological complex paired with a famous artisan market down in the valley town. View Guide NATURE 15 km 30m by car Sacred Valley of the Incas A picturesque valley dotted with traditional Inca villages, agricultural terraces, and impressive archaeological ruins. evidence: Skip to main content ROOMS SERVICES EXPLORE CUSCO GALLERY CONTACT EN Sign In Book Now NEARBY 08 Explore Cusco Discover the wonders that await just outside your door All Historical Nature Cultural Adventure HISTORICAL 112 km 4h by train Machu Picchu The iconic Inca citadel and UNESCO World Heritage Site. One of the New Seven Wonders of the World. View Guide NATURE 15 km 30m by car Sacred Valley of the Incas A picturesque valley dotted with traditional Inca villages, agricultural terraces, and impressive archaeological ruins. View Guide HISTORICAL 2 km 10m by car / 30m walk Sacsayhuaman An immense Inca fortress featuring megalithic stones fitted together with extraordinary precision above Cusco city. View Guide ADVENTURE 100 km 3h by car + 2h hike Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) A dramatic mountain displaying natural stripes of turquoise, gold, and magenta at 5,200 meters altitude. View Guide CULTURAL 0.3 km 3m walk San Pedro Central Market Cusco's most vibrant market, located steps from our hotel, overflowing with fresh juices, local foods, and handicrafts. View Guide CULTURAL 0.8 km 10m walk Cusco Plaza de Armas Cusco's historic central square, framed by the Cathedral, Church of the Society of Jesus, and colonial arcades. View Guide HISTORICAL 0.7 km 8m walk Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun) The most sacred temple of the Inca Empire, dedicated to the Sun God Inti, upon which Santo Domingo Convent was built. View Guide CULTURAL 1.2 km 15m walk San Blas Neighborhood Cusco's bohemian artisan quarter, famous for narrow cobblestone streets, woodcarving workshops, and panoramic views. View Guide NATURE 50 km 1h 30m by car Maras Salt Mines Over 3,000 terraced salt pools fed by a warm subterranean saltwater spring since pre-Inca times. View Guide HISTORICAL 53 km 1h 20m by car Moray Archaeological Site Striking concentric circular agricultural terraces designed by the Incas to simulate varied microclimates. View Guide HISTORICAL 60 km 1h 45m by car Ollantaytambo A living Inca town featuring a monumental fortress and terraces, serving as the main train station to Machu Picchu. View Guide CULTURAL 33 km 45m by car Pisac Archaeological Site & Market A vast hilltop archaeological complex paired with a famous artisan market down in the valley town. View Guide ADVENTURE 120 km 3h by car + 1.5h hike Humantay Lake A dazzling turquoise glacial lake sitting at the foot of the snow-capped Humantay Mountain at 4,200m elevation. evidence: Skip to main content ROOMS SERVICES EXPLORE CUSCO GALLERY CONTACT EN Sign In Book Now NEARBY 08 Explore Cusco Discover the wonders that await just outside your door All Historical Nature Cultural Adventure HISTORICAL 112 km 4h by train Machu Picchu The iconic Inca citadel and UNESCO World Heritage Site. One of the New Seven Wonders of the World. View Guide NATURE 15 km 30m by car Sacred Valley of the Incas A picturesque valley dotted with traditional Inca villages, agricultural terraces, and impressive archaeological ruins. View Guide HISTORICAL 2 km 10m by car / 30m walk Sacsayhuaman An immense Inca fortress featuring megalithic stones fitted together with extraordinary precision above Cusco city. View Guide ADVENTURE 100 km 3h by car + 2h hike Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) A dramatic mountain displaying natural stripes of turquoise, gold, and magenta at 5,200 meters altitude. View Guide CULTURAL 0.3 km 3m walk San Pedro Central Market Cusco's most vibrant market, located steps from our hotel, overflowing with fresh juices, local foods, and handicrafts. View Guide CULTURAL 0.8 km 10m walk Cusco Plaza de Armas Cusco's historic central square, framed by the Cathedral, Church of the Society of Jesus, and colonial arcades. View Guide HISTORICAL 0.7 km 8m walk Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun) The most sacred temple of the Inca Empire, dedicated to the Sun God Inti, upon which Santo Domingo Convent was built. View Guide CULTURAL 1.2 km 15m walk San Blas Neighborhood Cusco's bohemian artisan quarter, famous for narrow cobblestone streets, woodcarving workshops, and panoramic views. View Guide NATURE 50 km 1h 30m by car Maras Salt Mines Over 3,000 terraced salt pools fed by a warm subterranean saltwater spring since pre-Inca times. View Guide HISTORICAL 53 km 1h 20m by car Moray Archaeological Site Striking concentric circular agricultural terraces designed by the Incas to simulate varied microclimates. View Guide HISTORICAL 60 km 1h 45m by car Ollantaytambo A living Inca town featuring a monumental fortress and terraces, serving as the main train station to Machu Picchu. View Guide CULTURAL 33 km 45m by car Pisac Archaeological Site & Market A vast hilltop archaeological complex paired with a famous artisan market down in the valley town. View Guide ADVENTURE 120 km 3h by car + 1.5h hike Humantay Lake A dazzling turquoise glacial lake sitting at the foot of the snow-capped Humantay Mountain at 4,200m elevation.
